tools.name: npm-pre-install-report
tools.description: Before installing an npm or MCP package with network or token access, a version number is only a claim, and postinstall can fetch an unsigned tarball from a bare IP. $0.005 per call, USDC via x402 or MPP. Returns a pre-install report for an exact npm package version: tarball sha256, per-path hashes,

tools.name: package-check
tools.description: One call: give ecosystem (npm or pypi), name, and an optional version; get exists, a verdict (ok|caution|block) with reasons, latest, published_at, age_days, weekly_downloads, maintainers, install scripts, deprecated, OSV advisories, typo-squat match, license, and attributed sources. Not charged on
